claim_boundary: Legal macro origins, halos, grid and capacity for the integer macro map with analytical ASAP7 logic reservations; no placement of standard cells, no route, no timing, no IR/EM.

ROM_MAC_strip.basis: block-dot pool + its share of pool operand muxes, distributed beside ROM

ATTENTION.basis: BF16 pool (wo_a, attention) + its share of muxes

SU_VECTOR.basis: vector light+SFU lanes, Sinkhorn, softplus, select, quantisers

COLLECTIVE.basis: analytical counts 8 one-shot / 2 ctrl / 4 router (D1 open)

GATHER.basis: Engram gather slices + assembler (hub, beside VM)

HBM_SERVICE_logic.basis: per-stack indexer key control/head-sum/tail + KV streamer, one set per stack (ledger count 4); K-arbiter partition not sized (W2)

engine_profile_status: analytical m=2 width-scaled ASAP7 ledger (not RTL-instantiated; D2 open)

assumed_abstracts.ASSUMED_ucie_a_x64: 388.8 x 1043 um per x64 module (ledger, published module)

refit.basis: W10 placed pairs + model hub + power switches + always-on island

area.whitespace_note: die minus edge I/O, HBM service bands, hub, channels/rings and used ROM/MAC pair rows; includes unused pair slots and edge slivers.  Compare against the ledger's 81.5 mm2 overhead ASSUMPTION (PLL, clock spine, DFT, host), which is not otherwise reserved.

wire_model.basis: least-squares fit of routed fmax period vs LINK_UM over the express-link records

latency_crossings.rule: registers = ceil(L / segment) - 1; segment = (period - uncertainty - flop overhead) / ps_per_um; one-way added cycles = registers + 1 when registers > 0 (a register-to-register hop is 1 cycle)

bank_binding_rule: The k-th macro of a group in a die's bank map (results/floorplan/v41_die_bankmap_busiest_*.json entries, in order) binds to the k-th instance of that group in `instances`; instances of a group are listed nearest-to-VM first.

power_gating.basis: ASSUMED 5% of gated logic area for coarse-grain (ring/column) header/footer switches: coarse-grain gating carries less switch area than fine-grain (K. Shi, D. Howard, 'Challenges in sleep transistor design and implementation in low-power designs', DAC 2006, doi:10.1145/1146909.1146943; M. Keating et al., Low Power Methodology Manual, Springer 2007, ch. 5); no ASAP7 switch cell is characterised, so the fraction is not measured
gated: ROM field element strips (region clock gating + switches)
power_gating.token_path: no wake on the single-user token path: stage idle >= 219 us between tokens (W14 model)
